messages:
olga (people-ops): Quick question for payroll/tax: manager has a mid-cycle promotion with a deferred bonus component. Promo eff = 2026-08-10, bonus payable 2026-09-01. How do we record these separately so retro works and bonus taxes correctly?

raj (eng): Manager wants base increase effective 8/10 and a one-time deferred performance bonus on 9/1. Also need proration rules and rounding.

erin (payroll): Two separate actions in the CSV: set_salary with effective_date=2026-08-10 and one_time_bonus with effective_date=2026-09-01. Retro for base (8/10 -> end of pay period) is a retro_gross row. Bonus must be listed as bonus_taxable=true so payroll taxes it correctly on payout.

payroll-bot: Payroll bot: global retro import cutoff = 2026-08-20 23:59 UTC for US/EMEA/APAC. Uploads to sftp://payroll-uploads/global/retro. Validation report in #payroll-ops within 24h.

erin (payroll): Rounding: we round prorated amounts to cents using bankers rounding (to nearest cent, ties to even). Show managers a one-line sample calculation in the packet and include final numeric value in CSV.

raj (eng): Sample CSV?

erin (payroll): Paste-ready CSV (one employee example):

```
employee_id,first_name,last_name,action,old_annual,new_annual,effective_date,period_start,period_end,amount,currency,bonus_taxable,notes
55432,Raj,Patel,set_salary,98000,110000,2026-08-10,,,,,USD,false,"base salary set; retro in separate row"
55432,Raj,Patel,retro_gross,98000,110000,2026-08-10,2026-08-10,2026-08-31,900.17,USD,false,"prorated base for 8/10-8/31; calculation shown in packet"
55432,Raj,Patel,one_time_bonus,0,0,2026-09-01,,,,5000.00,USD,true,"deferred performance bonus payable 2026-09-01"
```

samir (tax-ops): Tax note: deferred bonus pays in a different payroll period; ensure tax jurisdiction for payout is correct. If employee changes country between 8/10 and 9/1 we need tax residency check. Also certain jurisdictions tax bonuses differently (flat rate vs aggregated). Add `payout_country` if different from salary country.

olga (people-ops): Good call. Edge case: manager also wants to backdate effective_date to 8/01 for compops reasons but keep payout 9/1. Can we set effective_date earlier than paperwork?

erin (payroll): Payroll will only accept effective_date per signed docs. If compops approves backdating we need signed approval attached and HR flag `backdate_approved:true`. Without that, payroll will process from paperwork date.

compops-bot: CompOps bot: to change effective date retroactively, open CompOps ticket with approval artifact and business justification. CompOps will route to legal/tax if needed.

raj (eng): What about benefits and contributions? If promo changes total cash and benefits like commuter allowance, do we add separate benefit rows?

erin (payroll): Add benefit changes as separate rows with action=benefit_change and specify amount and effective_date. Employer-side contributions follow set salary unless vendor rules require separate remittance.

olga (people-ops): Thanks. Action items: managers compute prorated base using template, include final numeric values, attach compops approvals if backdating, and upload CSV to SFTP by cutoff. We'll ping if tax residency checks are needed. :white_check_mark:
